newsitem.title: USA: FAA proposes $375,000 fine against Texas airline.
newsitem.headline: FAA proposes $375,000 fine against Texas airline.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration on Friday said it has proposed a fine of $375,000 against Exec Express II Inc for improper shipment of flammable hazardous materials while doing business as Lone Star Airlines.

The FAA said it issued a Notice of Civil Penalty on July 2 against the airline, which is based in Fort Worth, Texas. FAA said the airline shipped a fiberboard package containing an adhesive used to to seal fuel tank leaks which is a "flammable hazardous material."

The agency also said the airline failed to properly classify, package and label the cargo and to instruct its officers, agents and employees on proper federal guidelines for transport of hazardous material.
